title: Waymo Opens Fully Autonomous Rides to Everyone in Three Cities
key_facts: Waymo opened its fully autonomous ride-hailing service to the general public in San Antonio, San Diego and Tampa on 14 Oct 2026.
Anyone in the three cities can now download the Waymo app and hail a ride; the opening includes fully autonomous service at San Antonio International Airport.
Waymo says it has welcomed hundreds of thousands of riders in the three cities since early access began in 2026.
Earlier access was by invitation: San Antonio from 24 Feb 2026, San Diego and Tampa from 1 Sep 2026.
Waymo says data from over 127 million miles showed a ten-fold reduction in serious-injury-or-worse crashes compared with human drivers (company figure from the February announcement).
Co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana said in February that Waymo was on track for over one million rides a week by the end of 2026.
quote_evidence: Waymo opened its fully autonomous ride-hailing service to the general public in San Antonio, San Diego, and Tampa on October 14, 2026, announcing that anyone in the three cities can download the Waymo app and hail a ride.
The opening includes fully autonomous service at San Antonio International Airport.
With the October 14, 2026 opening, anyone in San Antonio, San Diego, and Tampa can download the Waymo app and ride, the company said.
why_it_matters_hint: Robotaxi rides are no longer invitation-only in three more US cities, including airport pickups in San Antonio.
